description:
Reads the electronic invoice out of a hybrid PDF: the embedded file streams, the
    associated files array and the XMP packet of a Factur-X, ZUGFeRD 2.x or comparable
    container, and from there the ordinary import path of esj-xr. Nothing is extracted
    from the visual page content: a PDF without an embedded structured invoice is
    reported as such and nothing else is attempted.
